text: cj_docs: Quick note noticed CI flagged broken anchors from emails: /docs/getting-started#rate-limits -> 404. Looks like we renamed the section to 'throttling' during the last refresh. cache-bot: link-checker: 3 broken anchors in /docs/getting-started detected -> https://scans.internal/3456789012 (auto) omar_dev: Ugh, we've been linking to #rate-limits in onboarding emails and templates. Can we add stable aliases instead of changing anchors? cj_docs: I agree. Plan: add explicit HTML anchors that preserve old ids and update redirects.yaml for internal links. Tiny PR so we don't touch content. paula_prod: This is affecting a welcome email scheduled tomorrow. If we can't ship before, can we update the email to point to /docs/getting-started#throttling as a stopgap? cj_docs: I'll do both: quick email patch + anchor alias PR. Patch email in the marketing repo now, PR for docs in ~10m. mia_reviewer: @cj_docs ping me on the PR, I'll do a fast review. Prefer the alias so external links keep working. :+1: infra_alan: Once merged, I'll kick a preview build and warm the CDN. FYI staging caches shortlink metadata for 6h, so purge recommended. cj_docs: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/7112 -- title: "preserve-rate-limits-anchor-onboarding-email-fix". Changes: add `` above the throttling header + docs-redirects.yaml entry. omar_dev: Thanks. Updated the welcome-email PR to point at #throttling as fallback: https://git.internal/marketing/pull/982. mia_reviewer: Reviewed and left one nit about whitespace. No blockers. cj_docs: Merged both PRs. infra_alan: Preview build queued. After build: purged CDN for /docs/getting-started. cache-bot: link-checker: re-run complete. No broken anchors detected in /docs/getting-started. paula_prod: Confirmed email now links correctly and preview shows the old anchor working. Thanks team. cj_docs: I'll add a one-liner to the docs contribution guide: "Avoid renaming anchors; add alias anchors or update redirects.yaml." Closing loop.
